title: Detection of viable Dichelobacter nodosus by real-time PCR using PMAxx™
author: Peter Kuhnert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbh9ij96
materials: VetMAX™ Xeno™ Internal Positive Control DNA

steps.title: Prepare sample suspension
steps.instruction: Place or dissolve the Dichelobacter nodosus sample in 50 µl of 0.85 % NaCl in a transparent 1.5 ml tube.

steps.title: Add PMAxx dye
steps.instruction: In a darkened room, add 0.25 µl of 100 µM PMAxx™ to the tube.

steps.title: Mix and incubate in dark
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube and incubate for 3 min at room temperature inside a metal box that is impervious to light.

steps.title: Photoactivate on ice
steps.instruction: After incubation, place the tube on ice and expose it to LED white light (100 W, 6000 K, 8500 lm) positioned 20 cm away for 5 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 15 000 × g for 5 min in a microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Hold the tube horizontally and use twisted tissues to absorb and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse pellet in SV‑lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 500 µl SV‑lysis buffer (4 M guanidine thiocyanate, 0.01 M Tris–HCl, 1 % β‑mercaptoethanol).

steps.title: Add internal extraction control
steps.instruction: Add 2 µl VetMAX™ Xeno™ Internal Positive Control DNA to the lysate (serves as extraction and later PCR control).

steps.title: Add magnetic beads and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add 30 µl MagneSil®RED to the tube and resuspend gently without vortexing.

steps.title: Extract DNA and elute
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using a KingFisher™ Duo Prime Purification System (or any equivalent magnetic‑bead platform) and elute the purified DNA in 60 µl H₂O.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: In a clean tube, assemble a 25 µl PCR reaction containing:

substeps.instruction: pyrogen‑free water (to bring volume to 25 µl)
2.5 µl of the extracted DNA template

steps.title: Set up duplicate PCR reactions
steps.instruction: Prepare at least duplicate reactions for each sample and load them onto a compatible instrument such as the 7500 Real‑Time PCR System.

steps.title: Run real‑time PCR program
steps.instruction: Run the following thermal profile: 2 min at 50 °C, 10 min at 95 °C, then 40 cycles of 15 s at 95 °C followed by 1 min at 60 °C.

steps.title: Analyze data with software
steps.instruction: Analyze the results using Sequence Detector 7500 software (v 2.3) with the fluorescence threshold set to 0.015.
